entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: A pastoral plane of anthropomorphic animals where visiting planeswalkers are animal-shifted; Magic's first all-animal plane.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: The rural and vibrant home region of Bloomburrow's animalfolk, with meadows, ponds, marshes, hills and thickets.

entities.name: Animalfolk
entities.description: The sapient, magic-using animal inhabitants of Bloomburrow, including mousefolk, frogfolk, ratfolk, lizardfolk, squirrelfolk, batfolk and others.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Huge non-sapient elemental creatures that are living seasons, bringing disaster as they move through the landscape.

entities.name: Beza
entities.description: The Calamity Beast that brings spring.

entities.name: Sun Hawk
entities.description: The Calamity Beast that brings summer.

entities.name: Blizzard Elk
entities.description: The Calamity Beast that brings winter.

entities.name: Eluge
entities.description: The Calamity Beast of the Season of Deep Waters, which flooded Three Tree City.

entities.name: Wildsear
entities.description: The Calamity Beast of the Season of Flames, which turned the tide in the War of Cinders and was driven off by Lily of Valley.

entities.name: Maha
entities.description: The Calamity Beast of the Season of Long Night, which destroyed Pondside and attacked other villages.

entities.name: Ygra
entities.description: The Calamity Beast of the Season of Salt.

entities.name: Order of the Holly Leaf
entities.description: A once mighty group of soldiers formed by animalfolk who survived underground, guardians of the sword Cragflame.

entities.name: Lily of Valley
entities.description: The champion of the Order of the Holly Leaf who wielded the Seed Flame and made Cragflame from Wildsear's tooth.

entities.name: Cragflame
entities.description: A sword fashioned from Wildsear's broken tooth, guarded by the Order of the Holly Leaf.

entities.name: Seed Flame
entities.description: A flame Lily of Valley wielded to weaken the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: War of Cinders
entities.description: A war of two generations between animalfolk and the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Weaving
entities.description: The nature-derived magic of the animalfolk, whose great forms drove some weavers mad and were sealed.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: The frog king of Fountainport who hired Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: A weaselfolk mercenary who led the Direshade Company and stole a Calamity Beast's egg.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: The leader of a group of small warriors and misfits who returned the egg and stopped the Beasts.

entities.name: Direshade Company
entities.description: A mercenary band led by Cruelclaw, defeated by Mabel's party in Fountainport.

entities.name: Pawpatch Party
entities.description: A group of rabbitfolk warriors who patrol Valley against Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Belladonna
entities.description: A covert squirrel faction of luddites aspiring to reclaim the world for nature.

entities.name: Fountainport
entities.description: A three-tiered fountain city ruled by King Glarb, where Mabel's party defeated the Direshades.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: The largest settlement in Valley, flooded by the Flood Gar.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: A frogfolk village destroyed by Maha around 4564 AR.

entities.name: Haymeadow
entities.description: A Valley location attacked by a Calamity Beast.

entities.name: Goodhill
entities.description: A diverse town with petal roofs and batfolk homes on poles.

entities.name: Calamity Graveyard
entities.description: A tar pit holding bones of Calamity Beasts killed in the war of cinders, source of squirrelfolk necromancy.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that Bloomburrow, or at least Valley, was likely not subject to.

events.summary: In the distant Season of Chaos the animalfolk survive underground and band together to form the Order of the Holly Leaf.
events.quote: the animalfolk survived buried underground until they banded together forming the Order of the Holly Leaf

events.summary: The animalfolk develop weaving and win their first victories against the weaker Calamity Beasts.
events.quote: had their first victories against the weaker Calamity Beasts

events.summary: Wildsear turns the tide against the animalfolk during the War of Cinders.
events.quote: until Wildsear, the wildfire wolf, turned the tide against the animalfolk

events.summary: Lily of Valley wields the Seed Flame, drives off Wildsear and forges Cragflame from its broken tooth in the final battle.
events.quote: she drove the weakened Wildsear away from Valley and fashioned the sword Cragflame from its broken tooth

events.summary: Magic drives some weavers mad into rage-fueled monsters, so the great weavings are sealed.
events.quote: This led to the great weavings being sealed, in favor of small spells anyone could manage.

events.summary: With great weaving gone, the Calamity Beasts return and the animalfolk learn to cope using specialized small weaving, forming Valley's civilization.
events.quote: This specialization led to the formation of the actual civilization of Valley.

events.summary: King Glarb hires Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg, reawakening the Beasts' fury.
events.quote: King Glarb hired the weaselfolk mercenary Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg, reawakening their fury

events.summary: Maha attacks villages including Pondside and Fountainport, and the Flood Gar floods Three Tree City.
events.quote: Maha attacked multiple villages, including Pondside and Fountainport, and the Flood Gar flooded Three Tree City.

events.summary: Mabel's group of small warriors and misfits returns the egg, stopping the Beasts.
events.quote: A group of small warriors and misfits under the leadership of Mabel returned the egg, stopping the Beasts.

events.summary: Mabel's party defeats the Direshade Company in Fountainport; they surrender or escape with their leader.
events.quote: After their defeat by Mabel’s party in Fountainport, they either surrendered to authorities or escaped the city with their leader.

relations.quote: It was destroyed by Maha around 4564 AR

relations.note: Valley is a small region of the larger plane.
relations.quote: A small region in the larger plane of Bloomburrow

relations.note: The Order guarded the magical sword.
relations.quote: were the guardians of the magical sword Cragflame
